objective_for_doctor: Evaluate and manage a pediatric patient presenting with a 3-week history of generalized fatigue, easy bruising, fever, and severe leg pain.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: I’ve been feeling very tired for about three weeks and I bruise easily. In the past week I also developed a fever and bad leg pain that wakes me up at night.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any involuntary movements recently—like twitching, jerking, shaking, or sudden uncontrollable movements that you can’t stop? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No—I haven’t had any twitching, jerking, shaking, or uncontrollable movements.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed a **lump in your right breast that doesn’t hurt** and feels like it **moves or shifts** when you touch it? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No—I haven’t noticed any lump in my right breast, and I don’t feel anything that moves or shifts.”

turns.doctor_question: When you press or gently tap around your belly button area, does it feel tender or painful? (yes/no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, when you press around my belly button area it doesn’t feel tender or painful.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been vomiting recently (yes or no)?
Have you noticed a lump or mass in your **right breast** (for example, a new or growing area you can feel)?
turns.patient_answer: “No— I haven’t noticed any lump or mass in my right breast, and there isn’t anything new or growing that I can feel.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you notice that the lenses in **both** of your eyes look **cloudy or hazy**, like you’re seeing through a fogged-up window? (Yes/No)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed that either eye looks cloudy or hazy, and my vision doesn’t seem foggy.”

turns.doctor_question: In the past 6 to 12 months, have you lost weight without trying (for example, your clothes fit looser or the scale went down), even though you didn’t change your diet or exercise?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t lost weight without trying, and my clothes don’t seem any looser.”
